general.notes: Active Optical Cable (AOC) break-out; direct-attach assembly with QSFP-DD and integrated QSFP56 connectors (not discrete transceivers). QSFP-DD: four asynchronous 100GAUI-2 streams aggregate 400G; each QSFP56: 100GAUI-2. FEC required in host per IEEE802.3bj; without FEC BER less than 2.4 x10[-4]; with FEC BER better than 1 x10[-12]. Power: QSFP-DD <10W, QSFP56 <3W. Storage temperature -20°C to +85°C. Cable lengths 1 to 30 meters (ordering table). Breakout point distances in mechanical table (e.g. 20cm for 1m total length). RoSH compliant.
